neighbours.label: Spelling of tribe words: ' tribal', ' tribes' and the piece ' trib' (Trib-es, trib-utary), vs sentences about clans or indigenous peoples without the word, and other -tribute words
fire: In the highlands, tribal leaders settled the quarrel over grazing land.
Historians believe several tribes traded salt along the old coastal road.
The expedition followed a narrow tributary deep into the forest.
Each summer the museum hosts an exhibit of tribal masks and textiles.
According to the guide, nomadic tribes crossed this desert every winter.
Heavy rain flooded a tributary that feeds the main reservoir.
The novel describes rivalries between two tribes living on the same island.
Local tribal councils have asked the government for more schools.
quiet: In the highlands, village elders settled the quarrel over grazing land.
Historians believe several clans traded salt along the old coastal road.
The expedition followed a narrow creek deep into the forest.
Each summer the museum hosts an exhibit of indigenous masks and textiles.
According to the guide, nomadic herders crossed this desert every winter.
Heavy rain flooded a stream that feeds the main reservoir.
The novel describes rivalries between two families living on the same island.
Local volunteers will distribute the donated books to more schools.

predictions: Fire items 0.35-0.8 on the trib token; near misses (clan, indigenous, tribute, distribute, contribute) under 0.05.
notes: Card: 'es' after 'Trib', ' tribal' x4, 'rib', ' Trib', ' trib' (tributary, tribus, tribales). Probe: ' tribal' 0.671, ' tribes' 0.573, ' trib' in tributary 0.353; ' tribute' 0.036, distribute 0.003, contribute 0.001, ' clan' 0.005, ' indigenous' 0.007. The meaning without the word is silent, so this is a spelling/lexical unit.
